styles.summary: Global styles (src/styles/ + styles.scss): 156 B at scaffold → 31.2 KB/12 files by 06-25 → peaked ~82.4 KB on 08-02 → fell to 58.6 KB/13 files (~2.6k LOC) at HEAD — a real ~29% shrink in the final week (comment purge + words-explorer partial cleanups). Component SCSS keeps climbing: 52 files/90 KB (06-25) → 108 files/171.9 KB (~7.7k LOC) at HEAD; component styles now outweigh global styles ~3:1 by bytes.

notes: Monorepo history begins 2026-06-06 ('chore: scaffold fullstack workspace'); Backend and Frontend were separate repos tracked as submodules until git-subtree imports on 2026-07-10 (258a8d1b, 6e023081). All pre-import per-file history lives on the imported parent lines (dc9fd9c1, 0f4cedc3) at unprefixed paths — plain `git log -- Backend/…` silently misses it.

Total repo lifespan is only ~9 weeks (2026-06-06 → 2026-08-08); every 'growth curve' here is a two-month curve, and the documentation-hygiene regime (lifecycle rule, comment ban, mirror verification) all dates from the last 2 of those weeks (07-27 onward).

The 6-file AGENTS/CLAUDE duplication costs ~26.3 KB of tracked bytes of which ~22.3 KB (root 14915 + Backend 7335) is byte-identical mirror content maintained by hand; drift between root mirrors has recurred 3 times and each resync needed an audit finding to notice.

git log --follow on the root AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md crosses rename detection into the Backend copies (inflating counts to 65/90); no-follow counts (42/64) are the honest per-path numbers and are what agents_claude_history reports.
UI_STYLE_SYSTEM.md numstat totals double-count one PR-merge + release-merge pair (26dcab9e/fef39610); trajectory tail is ~10% above the file's true 1658 lines.
TESTING_DEBT row-churn counts treat an edited row as one add plus one remove; 74 added / 41 removed brackets the true creation/payback rate rather than measuring it exactly.
.codex/ is invisible to git (untracked, empty); any claim about 'when it appeared' can only come from filesystem mtime (Aug 7), not history — UNKNOWN origin date.
